## Resolution discovered during plan review

A4-3 requires no new code. A4-1 already removed the operational cost at the correct call-site boundary and intentionally preserved the pure differ contract.

`compute_mutations` documents its first argument as real local state, so an empty local entry versus populated Jira fields remains a valid raw field-drift emission. The production snapshot caller is the exceptional site: it passes two remote snapshots. A4-1, merged as Gerrit 1256 / `6cdd4b00d9ee` with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, filters differ-owned `field_drift` and `unbound_local` mutations immediately after the raw differ. Existing source commentary and positive-control tests make that placement explicit and removable if the caller is later migrated to real local state.

The originally proposed branch-3 short-circuit would violate that design and break load-bearing raw-differ tests. This story closes by verifying the landed call-site behavior, its positive controls, converged mutation count, and zero per-mutation git calls, then recording the no-change decision.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] [code-verifiable] The raw differ still emits its documented field-drift positive control, while the production snapshot call site filters it to zero outbound updates.
- [x] [code-verifiable] Genuine inbound-create and invariant-seed mutations survive the filter.
- [x] [code-verifiable] A converged pass records `mutation_count == 0`.
- [x] [code-verifiable] A live counting probe records exactly zero per-mutation `git rev-parse` calls after the filter.
- [x] [operator-attested] The A4-1 Gerrit evidence, exact verification commands, results, and no-change rationale are recorded on the implementation child.

## File impact

None. This story verifies and accepts the A4-1 call-site design.
